_doc: The flat-engine's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/flat_engine.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/flat_engine/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. iron is the drum, the chimney and the fittings (lacquer_black iron with brass bands going to bronze_patina, wet below the splash line, by vertex colour and wetness; no emission). window is the salt-glass porthole lit from inside by its bound light (glimmer_bound, steady, never pulsing: README rule 3, color_script.md rule 2); the broken mesh's crazed glass has no emission mask, so it is dark. timber is the eight paddles (timber_weathered, darkened wet on the water). hinge is the paddle hinges' marks, the weak points: spawn_wound, its slow weak-point pulse (ADR 0151: one small closed mark each), dark on the broken mesh. Colours are palette.json swatches.
